name: M_Convert
program:
------------------------------------------------------------
--| Function   : convert Eular angle into Axis-angle
--| Parameter  : r_degree_x, r_degree_y, r_degree_z:real
--| Return     :
--| Called     :
--| Call       :
--| Date       : 2025.02.15
--| Programmer : yizhu@siemens.com
------------------------------------------------------------
param r_degree_x, r_degree_y, r_degree_z:real, bol_applied:boolean := False


var r_ab_degree_x:real := abs(r_degree_x)
var r_ab_degree_y:real := abs(r_degree_y)
var r_ab_degree_z:real := abs(r_degree_z)

var r_minus_degree_x: real := when r_degree_x > 0 then 1 else -1
var r_minus_degree_y: real := when r_degree_y > 0 then 1 else -1
var r_minus_degree_z: real := when r_degree_z > 0 then 1 else -1

var arr_x:real[4] := [r_ab_degree_x, r_minus_degree_x, 0, 0]
var arr_y:real[4] := [r_ab_degree_y, 0, r_minus_degree_y, 0]
var arr_z:real[4] := [r_ab_degree_z, 0, 0, r_minus_degree_z]

var Rotation:any
switch current.TypeofRotation
case \"XYZ\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_x, arr_y)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_z)
case \"XZY\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_x, arr_z)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_y)
case \"YXZ\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_y, arr_x)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_z)
case \"YZX\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_y, arr_z)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_x)
case \"ZXY\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_z, arr_x)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_y)
case \"ZYX\
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(arr_z, arr_y)
\tRotation := basis.~._3D.concatenateRotations(Rotation, arr_x)
else
\tdebug
end

-- Refresh results
current.M_RefreshResults(Rotation)

if bol_applied
\t-- Rotate
\tcurrent.M_AutomaticRotate(Rotation)
end

--| Parameter  : payload:string, destParent:object

--| Called     : M_Paste, M_OnReceive
--| Call       : M_Split, M_Decode, M_SetTableCell, M_SetVariableValue
--| Date       : 2026.07.20
--| Programmer : ModelSyncCopy
------------------------------------------------------------
param payload:string, destParent:object
-> object
var FS:string := strChr(1)
var RS:string := strChr(2)
var recs:string[]
var h:string[]
var f:string[]
var objName:string
var objPath:string
var pol:string
var objType:string
var suffix:integer := 1
var i:integer
var col:integer
var row:integer
var classPath:string
var valueType:string
var valueText:string
var newObj:object
var cells:integer := 0
var skipped:integer := 0
if destParent = void then return void end
if destParent.InternalClassName /= \"Network\" then
    current.LastSummary := \"target is not a Frame\
    return void
end
recs := current.M_Split(payload, RS)
if recs.Dim < 1 then return void end
h := current.M_Split(recs[1], FS)
if h.Dim < 8 or h[1] /= \"MSCO\" or h[2] /= \"v1\" then
    current.LastSummary := \"invalid MSCO payload\
    return void
end
objType := h[4]
objName := current.M_Decode(h[5])
objPath := to_str(destParent, \".\", objName)
pol := current.OnCollision
if existsObject(objPath)
    if pol = \"skip\
        current.LastSummary := \"skipped: target exists\
        return void
    elseif pol = \"rename\
        while existsObject(to_str(objPath, \"_\", suffix)) and suffix < 999
            suffix += 1
        end
        objName := to_str(objName, \"_\", suffix)
    else
        str_to_obj(objPath).deleteObject
    end
end
switch objType
case \"M\
    if h.Dim < 9 then return void end
    newObj := .InformationFlow.&Method.derive(destParent, objName)
    newObj.Coordinate3D := [str_to_num(h[6]), str_to_num(h[7]), str_to_num(h[8])]
    newObj.Program := current.M_Decode(h[9])
    current.LastSummary := to_str(\"type=Method name=\", objName, \" sourceVersion=\", h[3])
case \"P\
    if h.Dim < 10 then return void end
    classPath := current.M_Decode(h[9])
    if not existsObject(classPath)
        current.LastSummary := to_str(\"PythonModule class not found: \", classPath)
        return void
    end
    newObj := str_to_obj(classPath).derive(destParent, objName)
    newObj.Coordinate3D := [str_to_num(h[6]), str_to_num(h[7]), str_to_num(h[8])]
    newObj.PythonCode := current.M_Decode(h[10])
    current.LastSummary := to_str(\"type=PythonModule name=\", objName,
        \" codeChars=\", strLen(newObj.PythonCode), \" sourceVersion=\", h[3])
case \"V\
    if h.Dim < 10 then return void end
    valueType := current.M_Decode(h[9])
    valueText := current.M_Decode(h[10])
    newObj := .InformationFlow.&Variable.derive(destParent, objName)
    newObj.Coordinate3D := [str_to_num(h[6]), str_to_num(h[7]), str_to_num(h[8])]
    newObj.DataType := valueType
    if not current.M_SetVariableValue(newObj, valueType, valueText)
        current.LastSummary := to_str(\"unsupported Variable value type: \", valueType)
        newObj.deleteObject
        return void
    end
    current.LastSummary := to_str(\"type=Variable name=\", objName, \" dataType=\",
        valueType, \" sourceVersion=\", h[3])
case \"T\
    if h.Dim < 16 then return void end
    newObj := .InformationFlow.DataTable.derive(destParent, objName)
    newObj.Coordinate3D := [str_to_num(h[6]), str_to_num(h[7]), str_to_num(h[8])]
    newObj.DataType := current.M_Decode(h[9])
    newObj.DataTypeColumnIndex := current.M_Decode(h[10])
    newObj.RowIndex := strToUpper(h[11]) = \"TRUE\
    newObj.ColumnIndex := strToUpper(h[12]) = \"TRUE\
    newObj.MaxXDim := round(str_to_num(h[13]))
    newObj.setDataType(0, current.M_Decode(h[16]))
    for i := 2 to recs.Dim
        f := current.M_Split(recs[i], FS)
        if f.Dim >= 3 and f[1] = \"D\
            newObj.setDataType(round(str_to_num(f[2])), current.M_Decode(f[3]))
        end
    next
    for i := 2 to recs.Dim
        f := current.M_Split(recs[i], FS)
        if f.Dim < 3 then continue end
        switch f[1]
        case \"H\
            col := round(str_to_num(f[2]))
            newObj[col,0] := current.M_Decode(f[3])
            cells += 1
        case \"R\
            if f.Dim >= 4
                row := round(str_to_num(f[2]))
                if current.M_SetTableCell(newObj, 0, row, current.M_Decode(f[3]), current.M_Decode(f[4]))
                    cells += 1
                else
                    skipped += 1
                end
            end
        case \"K\
            if f.Dim >= 5
                col := round(str_to_num(f[2]))
                row := round(str_to_num(f[3]))
                if current.M_SetTableCell(newObj, col, row, current.M_Decode(f[4]), current.M_Decode(f[5]))
                    cells += 1
                else
                    skipped += 1
                end
            end
        end
    next
    current.LastSummary := to_str(\"type=DataTable name=\", objName, \" columns=\", h[14],
        \" rows=\", h[15], \" cells=\", cells, \" skipped=\", skipped,
        \" sourceVersion=\", h[3])
else
    current.LastSummary := to_str(\"unsupported MSCO type: \", objType)
    return void
end
return newObj

program:
------------------------------------------------------------
--| Function   : recursively serialize all supported Frame contents
--| Parameter  : sourceFrame:object, parentRel:string, sourceBasePath:string
--| Return     : string (RS-prefixed records)
--| Called     : M_BuildFrame, M_BuildFrameNodes
--| Call       : M_BuildObject, M_BuildFrameMeta, M_Encode,
--|              M_ReadAttribute, M_ReadMethodCode, M_ShouldSkipAttribute
--| Date       : 2026.07.20
--| Programmer : ModelSyncCopy
------------------------------------------------------------
param sourceFrame:object, parentRel:string, sourceBasePath:string
-> string
var FS:string := strChr(1)
var RS:string := strChr(2)
var out:string := \"\
var nodeObj:object
var succObj:object
var attrName:string
var attrType:string
var value:string
var classPath:string
var classRef:string
var classScope:string
var sourceRel:string
var targetRel:string
var payload:string
var isUser:string
var refScope:string
var attrTable:table
var k:integer
var attrRow:integer
var userAttrRow:integer
var succNo:integer
var succCount:integer
var coords := [0,0,0]
for k := 1 to sourceFrame.NumNodes
    nodeObj := sourceFrame.node(k)
    if nodeObj = void then continue end
    sourceRel := nodeObj.Name
    if parentRel /= \"\" then sourceRel := to_str(parentRel, \".\", nodeObj.Name) end
    coords := nodeObj.Coordinate3D
    switch nodeObj.InternalClassName
    case \"Network\
        classPath := to_str(nodeObj.Class)
        classScope := \"A\
        classRef := classPath
        if strLPos(sourceBasePath, classPath) = 1
            classScope := \"R\
            classRef := strCopy(classPath, strLen(sourceBasePath) + 2, 1000000000)
        end
        out := to_str(out, RS, \"F\", FS, current.M_Encode(parentRel), FS,
            current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS, classScope, FS,
            current.M_Encode(classRef), FS, current.M_Encode(nodeObj.Name), FS,
            to_str(coords[1]), FS, to_str(coords[2]), FS, to_str(coords[3]))
        out := to_str(out, current.M_BuildFrameNodes(nodeObj, sourceRel, sourceBasePath))
        out := to_str(out, current.M_BuildFrameMeta(nodeObj, sourceRel, sourceBasePath))
    case \"Method\", \"NwData\", \"NwList2D\", \"PythonModule\
        payload := current.M_BuildObject(nodeObj)
        out := to_str(out, RS, \"S\", FS, current.M_Encode(parentRel), FS,
            current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS, current.M_Encode(nodeObj.Name), FS,
            current.M_Encode(payload))
    case \"NwArc\
        -- rebuilt from C records
    case \"NwDialog\
        out := to_str(out, RS, \"U\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
            current.M_Encode(nodeObj.InternalClassName))
    else
        if nodeObj.Class = void
            out := to_str(out, RS, \"U\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
                current.M_Encode(nodeObj.InternalClassName))
            continue
        end
        classPath := to_str(nodeObj.Class)
        classScope := \"A\
        classRef := classPath
        if strLPos(sourceBasePath, classPath) = 1
            classScope := \"R\
            classRef := strCopy(classPath, strLen(sourceBasePath) + 2, 1000000000)
        end
        out := to_str(out, RS, \"O\", FS, current.M_Encode(parentRel), FS,
            current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS, classScope, FS,
            current.M_Encode(classRef), FS, current.M_Encode(nodeObj.Name), FS,
            to_str(coords[1]), FS, to_str(coords[2]), FS, to_str(coords[3]))
        nodeObj.putAttributeNamesIntoTable(attrTable, true, false)
        for attrRow := 1 to attrTable.YDim
            attrName := attrTable[1,attrRow]
            attrType := attrTable[2,attrRow]
            if current.M_ShouldSkipAttribute(attrName, attrType) then continue end
            isUser := \"0\
            for userAttrRow := 1 to nodeObj.NumAttr
                if nodeObj.getAttrName(userAttrRow) = attrName
                    isUser := \"1\
                    exitLoop
                end
            next
            if attrType = \"method\" and isUser = \"1\
                value := current.M_ReadMethodCode(to_str(nodeObj), attrName)
                out := to_str(out, RS, \"A\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
                    current.M_Encode(attrName), FS, current.M_Encode(value))
            elseif attrType = \"method\" or attrType = \"path\" or attrType = \"object\
                value := current.M_ReadAttribute(to_str(nodeObj), attrName)
                if value = \"\" or value = \"VOID\" then continue end
                refScope := \"A\
                targetRel := value
                if strLPos(\"self.\", value) = 1
                    refScope := \"S\
                elseif strLPos(sourceBasePath, value) = 1
                    refScope := \"R\
                    targetRel := strCopy(value, strLen(sourceBasePath) + 2, 1000000000)
                end
                out := to_str(out, RS, \"W\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
                    current.M_Encode(attrName), FS, current.M_Encode(attrType), FS,
                    isUser, FS, refScope, FS, current.M_Encode(targetRel))
            else
                value := current.M_ReadAttribute(to_str(nodeObj), attrName)
                out := to_str(out, RS, \"P\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
                    current.M_Encode(attrName), FS, current.M_Encode(attrType), FS,
                    isUser, FS, current.M_Encode(value))
            end
        next
    end
next
for k := 1 to sourceFrame.NumNodes
    nodeObj := sourceFrame.node(k)
    if nodeObj = void then continue end
    sourceRel := nodeObj.Name
    if parentRel /= \"\" then sourceRel := to_str(parentRel, \".\", nodeObj.Name) end
    current.LastSummary := strChr(7)
    executeSilent(to_str(\".ModelAssistants.ModelSyncCopy.LastSummary := to_str(\",
        to_str(nodeObj), \".NumSucc)\"))
    if current.LastSummary = strChr(7) then continue end
    succCount := round(str_to_num(current.LastSummary))
    for succNo := 1 to succCount
        succObj := nodeObj.succ(succNo)
        if succObj = void then continue end
        if strLPos(sourceBasePath, to_str(succObj)) /= 1 then continue end
        targetRel := strCopy(to_str(succObj), strLen(sourceBasePath) + 2, 1000000000)
        out := to_str(out, RS, \"C\", FS, current.M_Encode(sourceRel), FS,
            current.M_Encode(targetRel))
    next
next
return out

        to_str(p[3]), FS, current.M_Encode(src.DataType), FS,
        current.M_Encode(current.M_ReadVariableValue(src)))

        current.M_Encode(src.Name), FS, to_str(p[1]), FS, to_str(p[2]), FS,
        to_str(p[3]), FS, current.M_Encode(src.DataType), FS,

        next
    end
    if src.RowIndex
        tp := src.getDataType(0)
        for row := 1 to src.YDim
            out := to_str(out, RS, \"R\", FS, row, FS, current.M_Encode(tp), FS,
                current.M_Encode(to_str(src[0,row])))
        next
    end
    for row := 1 to src.YDim
        for col := 1 to src.XDim
            tp := src.getDataType(col)
            out := to_str(out, RS, \"K\", FS, col, FS, row, FS,
                current.M_Encode(tp), FS, current.M_Encode(to_str(src[col,row])))
        next
    next
    return out
end
return \"\

name: M_OnReceive
program:
------------------------------------------------------------
--| Function   : buffer and apply complete MSCO/MSCF payloads
--| Parameter  : channelNo:integer, message:string
--| Return     : -
--| Called     : SocketServer.callback / SocketClient.callback
--| Call       : M_ApplyObject, M_ApplyFrame
--| Date       : 2026.07.19
--| Programmer : ModelSyncCopy
------------------------------------------------------------
param channelNo:integer, message:string
var FS:string := strChr(1)
var rest:string
var p:integer
var need:integer
var headerLen:integer
var payload:string
var dst:object
var newObj:object
current.RxBuffer := to_str(current.RxBuffer, message)
while true
    if strLen(current.RxBuffer) < 5 then return end
    if strCopy(current.RxBuffer, 1, 4) /= \"MSCL\" or strCopy(current.RxBuffer, 5, 1) /= FS
        current.LastError := \"Invalid socket stream header\
        current.RxBuffer := \"\
        return
    end
    rest := strCopy(current.RxBuffer, 6, 1000000000)
    p := strLPos(FS, rest)
    if p <= 0 then return end
    need := round(str_to_num(strCopy(rest, 1, p - 1)))
    if need <= 0
        current.LastError := \"Invalid socket payload length\
        current.RxBuffer := \"\
        return
    end
    headerLen := 5 + p
    if strLen(current.RxBuffer) < headerLen + need
        current.LastError := to_str(\"Receiving \", strLen(current.RxBuffer) - headerLen,
            \"/\", need, \" chars\")
        return
    end
    payload := strCopy(current.RxBuffer, headerLen + 1, need)
    current.RxBuffer := strCopy(current.RxBuffer, headerLen + need + 1, 1000000000)
    current.LastPayload := payload
    if not existsObject(current.TargetPath)
        current.LastError := to_str(\"Target not found on receive: \", current.TargetPath)
        return
    end
    dst := str_to_obj(current.TargetPath)
    if strCopy(payload, 1, 4) = \"MSCF\
        newObj := current.M_ApplyFrame(payload, dst)
    else
        newObj := current.M_ApplyObject(payload, dst)
    end
    if newObj = void
        current.LastError := to_str(\"Receive failed (\", current.LastSummary, \")\")
        return
    end
    current.LastError := to_str(\"Received \", to_str(newObj), \" [\", current.LastSummary, \"]\")
    if current.RxBuffer = \"\" then exitLoop end
end
